articles.title: Familywala wrap: Suman Ghosh reflects on collaboration with Shiboprosad Mukherjee
articles.summary: Fourteen individuals, including a police constable, are reportedly facing a lifetime ban for their involvement in a significant match-fixing scandal in Goan football. This incident underscores ongoing challenges with corruption in sports within India and signifies strict action being taken against those compromising athletic integrity. Further investigations into the illicit activities are anticipated.

articles.title: Embraer sets sights on India with 200-jet order target for local assembly
articles.summary: Brazilian aerospace firm Embraer proposes establishing a commercial jet final assembly line (FAL) in India, contingent on securing firm orders for over 200 aircraft from Indian carriers. This initiative could significantly boost India's aerospace manufacturing capabilities and 'Make in India' efforts, positioning the nation as a potential regional aviation production hub and enhancing its industrial self-reliance in the civil aviation sector.

articles.title: U.S. Submarine Maintenance Period Demonstrates Forward Sustainment in Australia
articles.summary: An AUKUS Integration & Acquisition report details US Navy involvement near HMAS Stirling, Western Australia, on the Indian Ocean's edge, dating back to last November. This likely covers collaborative defence activities, exercises, or integration efforts under the AUKUS security pact, aimed at enhancing interoperability and security cooperation among member nations in the Indo-Pacific region.

articles.title: Marvel's Original Thanos Actor Played A Classic Green Lantern Villain In The Arrowverse
articles.summary: Actor Damion Poitier played a substantial recurring role in The CW's popular superhero series 'The Flash'. Over the show's final five seasons, Poitier made multiple appearances, first introduced in the Season 5 episode 'Goldfaced'. His presence significantly contributed to the ongoing narrative and character development within the acclaimed science-fiction drama.
